capabilities.name: Task effects
capabilities.summary: Task wraps a deferred effect, and yield produces a value without an external effect.

capabilities.name: Command execution
capabilities.summary: Command execution fetches entity state, runs a decision, appends events, and retries consistency conflicts.

capabilities.name: Service transports
capabilities.summary: A transport builds endpoint handlers, assembles them, and runs the resulting transport.

capabilities.name: Integration adapters
capabilities.summary: Integration instances provide real and fake request runners, and selection binds a dispatcher.

capabilities.name: IDE asset routing
capabilities.summary: The IDE command serves embedded assets and falls back to its SPA entrypoint for unknown routes.

capabilities.name: Cabal and Nix toolchain
capabilities.summary: The root project selects Cabal packages, while Nix defines the compiler shell and local tooling.

extension_points.name: Transport implementation
extension_points.hint: Implement the request, response, and runnable types, then assemble endpoints, build command handlers, and run the transport.

extension_points.name: Integration implementation
extension_points.hint: Define the request response type and its real and fake runners; mkDispatcher binds them from the active selection.
